children: Just a few weeks after releasing GPT-6 Astra, OpenAI
has already expanded it with less pricey versions, with the introduction today of GPT-6 Sol and GPT-6 Luna.

"We trained GPT‑6 Sol and Luna with similar methods as GPT‑6 Astra, bringing the advances behind Astra's state-of-the-art performance in professional work, factuality, coding, computer use, and alignment to faster, more affordable models," OpenAI said.

The Sam Altman-led company has also reduced its token pricing for these models. For GPT-6 Sol, 1M input tokens cost $2 and 1M output tokens are $10. This is compared to $4 and $20, respectively, for GPT-5.6 Sol. Similarly, GPT-6 Luna charged $0.10 per 1M input tokens and $0.50 for 1M output tokens, compared to $0.20 and $1.20, respectively, for GPT-5.6 Luna.
OpenAI also indicated these models have improved benchmark scores compared to prior iterations.
"On DeepSWE v1.1, which tests performance on complex software-engineering tasks in real codebases, GPT‑6 Sol at max effort scores 68.8%, within 1.1 percentage points of Claude Fable 5's

highest score in the evaluation—69.9% at xhigh effort—at approximately 80% lower cost per task. GPT‑6 Luna at max effort scores 66.6%, comparable to Claude Opus 5 and Fable 5 at medium effort," the company said. "In these comparisons, Luna costs 93% less per task than Opus 5 and 96% less than Fable 5."

GPT‑6 Sol and GPT‑6 Luna are available in ChatGPT Work and Codex starting today for all Plus, Pro, Business, Enterprise and Edu users. Free and Go users can access GPT‑6 Luna in the desktop app. They are also available in the OpenAI API.

title: OpenAI expands GPT-6 universe with GPT-6 Sol and GPT-6 Luna
